description: This file implements the Server Connector interface for a WebRTC client, providing functions to create connectors, handle device communication, and manage WebSocket or HTTP long polling mechanisms for signaling server interaction.

classes.name: Connector
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for server connection implementations.

classes.name: WebsocketConnector
classes.description: Implementation of Connector using WebSocket for real-time communication.

classes.name: PollingConnector
classes.description: Implementation of Connector using HTTP long polling for message exchange.

classes.name: ParentController
classes.description: Interface for sending device UI information to operator UI.

classes.name: DeviceDisplaysMessage
classes.description: Abstract class representing display information for a device, to be sent to operator UI.

methods.name: deviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID from URL parameters.

methods.name: createConnector
methods.description: Creates and returns a connector object capable of communicating with the signaling server.

methods.name: createParentController
methods.description: Returns a real implementation of the ParentController, currently null.
